module_summary: HDLC bit-stream framer: a 10-state Moore FSM counts consecutive ones on the serial input and decodes flag, bit-stuff discard and error states as outputs.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Counts consecutive ones S0..S6 and enters SDISC/SFLAG/SERR detection states.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from SFLAG state: flag sequence 01111110 detected.

anchors.name: disc
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from SDISC: stuffed zero bit to discard.

anchors.name: err
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from SERR: seven or more consecutive ones.

groups.name: hdlc_fsm
groups.description: Ones-counting FSM with decoded flag, discard and error outputs.
